title: Voice waveform takes the prototype's fixed bars and playback; the bob goes
context: Live voice cards (lib/features/entry_cards/cards/voice_body.dart) draw 14 fixed bars that bob while playing, with no played colouring, playhead or tap-to-seek; the summary called those unchanged though live never had them.
outcome: 3-point bars with 2-point gaps, count from the width, seeded per log under a middle-heavy envelope; played bars coral, a playhead, tap-to-seek and a labelled slider semantics node; no bob. WaveformBars stays for the recorder and onboarding.
